description: Improve text display in the run inspector by fixing text wrapping issues and adding a copy functionality. Ensure that long text without spaces wraps properly and that inspector titles are appropriately truncated when too long. Add a copy button for the Message property to allow users to easily copy text content.
functional_requirements: Fix text wrapping for message content in the run inspector so that long text without spaces wraps to the next line instead of overflowing
Implement proper truncation for inspector titles to prevent them from becoming too wide and breaking the layout
Add a copy button next to the Message property that allows users to copy the message text to their clipboard with a single click
Ensure the copy button provides visual feedback (like a success indicator) when text is successfully copied
Maintain consistent styling with existing UI components for the copy button and text display elements
